text:
maria: Hey all — planning next week's architecture sync. Can folks confirm availability for Tue/Wed 10:30-11:30 PT? Need to lock 1 slot for RFC reviews + queue cleanup. cc @drew @kai

jon: Tue works for me. I have a brief infra RFC (5–7m) to slot.

kai: Wed is probably better — heads-up I have on-call Tue afternoon. If Tue is the only option I can swap.

sasha: I can cover triage + deck curation if needed. Prefer Tue but flexible.

maria: Notes: main goals — (1) review jon's infra RFC, (2) open triage for long-running PRs, (3) platform standards quick sync on config schema. Also want to try 10-minute "parking lot" for new model onboarding questions. Agenda draft below — please add bullets.

maria: ```Agenda draft
1) 10m - Quick updates + roll call
2) 15m - Infra RFC (jon) — decision: accept/needs follow-up
3) 20m - Triage: top 5 PRs & blockers
4) 10m - Platform config schema proposals (sasha)
5) 10m - Parking lot / open q's
Prep: upload slides to /shared/eng/arb/next before EOD Mon.
```

drew: I'm out Tue morning but can do Wed. If majority is Tue, I can join remote and watch recording.

jon: I'll upload RFC slides and a one-pager by EOD Mon. Can we also auto-assign an owner for "queue cleanup" — volunteers?

sasha: I'll take queue cleanup ownership for this round. I'll put a checklist in the doc.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Architecture Sync — RFC + Triage" on Tue 10:30 PT (maria invited jon, sasha). Link: https://calendar.example/ev/abc123

maria: Thanks! If calendar-bot created it and you can't make it @drew, please propose new time via the event — otherwise we'll keep Tue. Also adding a quick pre-read: https://docs.internal/arb/pre-reads/2026-03-xx

kai: If we're pushing to Tue, can we shorten platform schema slot to 5m and move parking lot to a follow-up? Need more time on ops SLOs next week.

maria: Good call. Updated agenda: shorten schema to 5m, add follow-up note. Finalizing and will ping again once attendees confirmed.

drew: OK I'll do my best to be there. Thanks @sasha for taking queue cleanup.
